TermAl SQLite schema ledger, revision 7 (Fable2, 2026-10-26 ~00:56Z; the authoritative copies are on w-feba31b85e17). r7 adds a new primary claimant: the e12a unadmitted-report outbox (w-df1ef323efe9 / w-e12abe9f8cbe, Termal::Coder; Architect2's ruling is note d392f6fecc5041e786edb71837bb7794 on w-e12a). It also turns everything after handoff-1 into one pool, so that no claimant waits behind an unready one.
PRIMARY store (floor on master 5b10b2a3: "2-metadata-units-2", from w-cce8fff7c62d):
1. LANDED: "2-metadata-units-2".
2. RESOLVED: handoff-1 (w-b9b17d9735ad + w-a108efba750a + companion w-9a356000735e; Sol-8e1f) sent the first complete READY at 2026-10-26 00:01:25Z (tree 9a686343). It takes "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1" and lands alone in gate C.
3. POOL after handoff-1 (r7): each next primary floor step goes to the claimant that produces the next COMPLETE READY to Merger2 on the then-latest landed floor lineage. Claimants, with their suffixes:
 a) directPrompt: w-a8af3a34d80a (Termal::Coder), "-direct-prompt-1";
 b) obligations-1, the JOINT floor: w-1e85dae945d4 (P0, Sol-license) with w-5139 (ruling 6cd7777d), "-obligations-1";
 c) delegations-1: w-4fad42a4ffe7 (Sol-1cee; ruling abb94a3d), "-delegations-1";
 d) unadmitted-outbox-1: w-df1e/w-e12a (Coder; ruling d392f6fe), "-unadmitted-outbox-1".
 Each prepares its storage step as a successor of "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1". A claimant whose predecessor is no longer the master floor at landing carries onto the landed floor before its final freeze and extends its string by the lineage convention (e.g. "2-metadata-units-2-handoff-1-obligations-1-unadmitted-outbox-1"). It then re-runs its migration and reader-floor tests, and its reviewers check the re-floor.
 Ties within one gate are not allowed: one floor step per gate.
STRICT publication order, with no sibling floors. Merger2 checks that the floor string extends exactly the floor on master at the time of landing.
e12a specifics (Architect2): optional session JSON now carries active capture, pinned closing jobs and a pending immutable ExecutionObserve outbox, and an older serde writer could strip them (C3 no silent loss). So it raises the primary minimum-reader floor through the EXISTING schema admission and migration: an old, unsupported application refuses before a typed load or rewrite, and exact request custody is preserved. No grants and no retroactive admission.
COORDINATION store (floor on master 5b10b2a3: coordination step 6, from w-44909af1b8bc, LANDED 2026-10-25 22:17Z):
- step 7: directPrompt (w-a8af3a34d80a).
No other coordination-floor change may land before step 7 without asking Fable2.
FEDERATION profile contract: a separate constant "2" (1150c838, via w-efeee). It is never the storage floor; federation compatibility must not key on any local floor.
No floor change: w-efeee, w-de6021f4b32f, w-aa7bb4e4e47f, w-3b6225f4da8b, w-616edd0409b9, w-16cbff19cd11, w-f94049a01cdf, w-e2972bb21221, w-d5e10300b0df, w-21de902ddbb4, w-e1053ea93543, w-9394d34f867e, w-eca76, w-c51b6b414885, w-ee6648196897, w-72bb75ecd583, w-30fb670cde06, w-8837ca2accca, w-5df8dd709bb8, w-5e74fca28c0d, w-6c0ce7adcdad, w-c7b546116c5a. Each must ask Fable2 before adding a step.
